query:
WITH
    logged_in_vessel_id AS (
        SELECT
            fiskeridir_vessel_id
        FROM
            all_vessels
        WHERE
            call_sign = $3
    ),
    own_trips AS (
        SELECT
            trip_id,
            start_timestamp,
            stop_timestamp,
            period,
            period_precision,
            COALESCE(
                trip_fuel_liter_used,
                benchmark_fuel_consumption_liter
            ) AS fuel_consumption_liter,
            landing_total_living_weight,
            distance,
            landing_total_price_for_fisher,
            haul_ids,
            price_for_fisher_is_estimated,
            benchmark_percentage_of_trip_covered_by_measurements
        FROM
            trips_detailed
        WHERE
            stop_timestamp >= $1
            AND stop_timestamp <= $2
            AND fiskeridir_vessel_id = (
                SELECT
                    fiskeridir_vessel_id
                FROM
                    logged_in_vessel_id
            )
            AND (
                $4::INT[] IS NULL
                OR landing_two_highest_species_group_quantum && $4
            )
    ),
    per_trip AS (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(
                JSONB_AGG(
                    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                        'tripId',
                        trip_id,
                        'startTimestamp',
                        start_timestamp,
                        'endTimestamp',
                        stop_timestamp,
                        'fuelConsumptionLiter',
                        fuel_consumption_liter,
                        'weightPerHour',
                        landing_total_living_weight / NULLIF(
                            (
                                EXTRACT(
                                    EPOCH
                                    FROM
                                        UPPER(COALESCE(period_precision, period)) - LOWER(COALESCE(period_precision, period))
                                ) / (60 * 60)
                            ),
                            0.0
                        ),
                        'weightPerDistance',
                        landing_total_living_weight / NULLIF((distance * $6), 0.0),
                        'weightPerFuelLiter',
                        landing_total_living_weight / NULLIF(fuel_consumption_liter, 0.0),
                        'catchValuePerFuelLiter',
                        landing_total_price_for_fisher / NULLIF(fuel_consumption_liter, 0.0),
                        'livingWeight',
                        landing_total_living_weight,
                        'valueNok',
                        landing_total_price_for_fisher,
                        'numHauls',
                        CARDINALITY(haul_ids),
                        'tripDurationSeconds',
                        EXTRACT(
                            EPOCH
                            FROM
                                UPPER(COALESCE(period_precision, period)) - LOWER(COALESCE(period_precision, period))
                        )::BIGINT
                    )
                ),
                '[]'
            )::TEXT AS per_trip
        FROM
            own_trips
    ),
    logged_in_user_values AS (
        SELECT
            SUM(fuel_consumption_liter) AS own_sum_fuel_consumption_liter,
            SUM(landing_total_living_weight) / NULLIF(
                (
                    SUM(
                        EXTRACT(
                            EPOCH
                            FROM
                                UPPER(COALESCE(period_precision, period)) - LOWER(COALESCE(period_precision, period))
                        )
                    ) / (60 * 60)
                ),
                0.0
            ) AS own_sum_weight_per_hour,
            SUM(landing_total_living_weight) / NULLIF(SUM((distance * $6)), 0.0) AS own_sum_weight_per_distance,
            SUM(landing_total_living_weight) / NULLIF(SUM(fuel_consumption_liter), 0.0) AS own_sum_weight_per_fuel_liter,
            SUM(landing_total_price_for_fisher) / NULLIF(SUM(fuel_consumption_liter), 0.0) AS own_sum_catch_value_per_fuel_liter,
            SUM(landing_total_living_weight) AS own_sum_living_weight,
            COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS own_num_trips,
            SUM(CARDINALITY(haul_ids))::BIGINT AS own_num_hauls,
            SUM(landing_total_price_for_fisher) AS own_value_nok,
            BOOL_OR(price_for_fisher_is_estimated) AS own_trips_has_price_estimation,
            SUM(
                benchmark_percentage_of_trip_covered_by_measurements
            ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS own_fuel_measurement_coverage_percentage,
            SUM(
                EXTRACT(
                    EPOCH
                    FROM
                        UPPER(COALESCE(period_precision, period)) - LOWER(COALESCE(period_precision, period))
                )
            )::BIGINT AS own_trip_duration_seconds,
            CASE
                WHEN SUM(landing_total_living_weight) > 0
                AND SUM(distance) > $8 THEN (SUM(fuel_consumption_liter) * $9)::DOUBLE PRECISION / (
                    SUM(landing_total_living_weight)::DOUBLE PRECISION / 1000::DOUBLE PRECISION
                )
                ELSE NULL
            END AS own_carbon_intensity,
            CASE
                WHEN SUM(landing_total_living_weight) > 0
                AND SUM(distance) > $8 THEN (SUM(fuel_consumption_liter) * $9)::DOUBLE PRECISION / (
                    SUM(landing_total_living_weight * distance * $6)::DOUBLE PRECISION / 1000::DOUBLE PRECISION
                )
                ELSE NULL
            END AS own_eeoi,
            (
                SELECT
                    COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(g.description), '{}')
                FROM
                    logged_in_vessel_id l
                    INNER JOIN vessel_yearly_groupings v ON v.fiskeridir_vessel_id = l.fiskeridir_vessel_id
                    INNER JOIN vessel_grouping_length_combinations c ON c.vessel_grouping_length_combination_id = v.vessel_grouping_length_combination_id
                    INNER JOIN vessel_groupings g ON g.vessel_grouping_id = c.vessel_grouping_id
                WHERE
                    v.year = ANY ($7::INT[])
            ) AS vessel_groupings
        FROM
            own_trips
    ),
    other_vessel_trips AS (
        SELECT
            fiskeridir_vessel_id,
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN fiskeridir_vessel_id = (
                        SELECT
                            fiskeridir_vessel_id
                        FROM
                            logged_in_vessel_id
                    ) THEN COALESCE(
                        trip_fuel_liter_used,
                        benchmark_fuel_consumption_liter
                    )
                    ELSE benchmark_fuel_consumption_liter_estimated_only
                END
            ) AS sum_fuel_consumption_liter,
            SUM(landing_total_living_weight) / NULLIF(
                (
                    SUM(
                        EXTRACT(
                            EPOCH
                            FROM
                                UPPER(COALESCE(period_precision, period)) - LOWER(COALESCE(period_precision, period))
                        )
                    ) / (60 * 60)
                ),
                0.0
            ) AS sum_weight_per_hour,
            SUM(landing_total_living_weight) / NULLIF(SUM((distance * $6)), 0.0) AS sum_weight_per_distance,
            SUM(landing_total_living_weight) / NULLIF(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN fiskeridir_vessel_id = (
                            SELECT
                                fiskeridir_vessel_id
                            FROM
                                logged_in_vessel_id
                        ) THEN COALESCE(
                            trip_fuel_liter_used,
                            benchmark_fuel_consumption_liter
                        )
                        ELSE benchmark_fuel_consumption_liter_estimated_only
                    END
                ),
                0.0
            ) AS sum_weight_per_fuel_liter,
            SUM(landing_total_price_for_fisher) / NULLIF(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN fiskeridir_vessel_id = (
                            SELECT
                                fiskeridir_vessel_id
                            FROM
                                logged_in_vessel_id
                        ) THEN COALESCE(
                            trip_fuel_liter_used,
                            benchmark_fuel_consumption_liter
                        )
                        ELSE benchmark_fuel_consumption_liter_estimated_only
                    END
                ),
                0.0
            ) AS sum_catch_value_per_fuel_liter,
            SUM(landing_total_living_weight) AS sum_living_weight,
            SUM(landing_total_price_for_fisher) AS value_nok,
            COUNT(*) AS num_trips,
            SUM(CARDINALITY(haul_ids)) AS num_hauls,
            SUM(
                EXTRACT(
                    EPOCH
                    FROM
                        UPPER(COALESCE(period_precision, period)) - LOWER(COALESCE(period_precision, period))
                )::BIGINT
            ) AS trip_duration_seconds,
            CASE
                WHEN SUM(landing_total_living_weight) > 0
                AND SUM(distance) > $8 THEN (
                    SUM(
                        CASE
                            WHEN fiskeridir_vessel_id = (
                                SELECT
                                    fiskeridir_vessel_id
                                FROM
                                    logged_in_vessel_id
                            ) THEN COALESCE(
                                trip_fuel_liter_used,
                                benchmark_fuel_consumption_liter
                            )
                            ELSE benchmark_fuel_consumption_liter_estimated_only
                        END
                    ) * $9
                )::DOUBLE PRECISION / (
                    SUM(landing_total_living_weight)::DOUBLE PRECISION / 1000::DOUBLE PRECISION
                )
                ELSE NULL
            END AS carbon_intensity,
            CASE
                WHEN SUM(landing_total_living_weight) > 0
                AND SUM(distance) > $8 THEN (
                    SUM(
                        CASE
                            WHEN fiskeridir_vessel_id = (
                                SELECT
                                    fiskeridir_vessel_id
                                FROM
                                    logged_in_vessel_id
                            ) THEN COALESCE(
                                trip_fuel_liter_used,
                                benchmark_fuel_consumption_liter
                            )
                            ELSE benchmark_fuel_consumption_liter_estimated_only
                        END
                    ) * $9
                )::DOUBLE PRECISION / (
                    SUM(landing_total_living_weight * distance * $6)::DOUBLE PRECISION / 1000::DOUBLE PRECISION
                )
                ELSE NULL
            END AS eeoi
        FROM
            trips_detailed
        WHERE
            stop_timestamp >= $1
            AND stop_timestamp <= $2
            AND (
                $4::INT[] IS NULL
                OR landing_two_highest_species_group_quantum && $4
            )
            AND fiskeridir_vessel_id = ANY ($5)
        GROUP BY
            fiskeridir_vessel_id
    ),
    other_vessels AS (
        SELECT
            MAX(sum_weight_per_hour) AS highest_weight_per_hour,
            MIN(sum_fuel_consumption_liter) AS lowest_fuel_consumption_liter,
            MAX(sum_weight_per_distance) AS highest_weight_per_distance,
            MAX(sum_weight_per_fuel_liter) AS highest_weight_per_fuel_liter,
            MAX(sum_catch_value_per_fuel_liter) AS highest_catch_value_per_fuel_liter,
            MAX(sum_living_weight) AS highest_living_weight,
            AVG(sum_weight_per_hour) AS average_weight_per_hour,
            AVG(sum_fuel_consumption_liter) AS average_fuel_consumption_liter,
            AVG(sum_weight_per_distance) AS average_weight_per_distance,
            AVG(sum_weight_per_fuel_liter) AS average_weight_per_fuel_liter,
            AVG(sum_catch_value_per_fuel_liter) AS average_catch_value_per_fuel_liter,
            AVG(sum_living_weight) AS average_living_weight,
            AVG(num_trips)::BIGINT AS average_num_trips,
            AVG(num_hauls)::BIGINT AS average_num_hauls,
            AVG(trip_duration_seconds)::BIGINT AS average_trip_duration_seconds,
            AVG(value_nok) AS average_value_nok
        FROM
            other_vessel_trips
    ),
    ranked_data AS (
        SELECT
            carbon_intensity,
            eeoi,
            percent_rank() OVER (
                ORDER BY
                    carbon_intensity
            ) AS percent_carbon_intensity,
            percent_rank() OVER (
                ORDER BY
                    eeoi
            ) AS percent_eeoi
        FROM
            other_vessel_trips
    ),
    average_carbon_intensity_and_eeoi AS (
        SELECT
            (
                SELECT
                    AVG(carbon_intensity) AS average_carbon_intensity
                FROM
                    ranked_data
                WHERE
                    percent_carbon_intensity BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.95
                    OR (
                        SELECT
                            COUNT(*)
                        FROM
                            other_vessel_trips
                    ) <= 2
            ) AS average_carbon_intensity,
            (
                SELECT
                    AVG(eeoi) AS average_eeoi
                FROM
                    ranked_data
                WHERE
                    percent_eeoi BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.95
                    OR (
                        SELECT
                            COUNT(*)
                        FROM
                            other_vessel_trips
                    ) <= 2
            ) AS average_eeoi
    ),
    other_vessel_stats AS (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(
                JSONB_AGG(
                    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                        'fiskeridirVesselId',
                        fiskeridir_vessel_id,
                        'weightPerHour',
                        sum_weight_per_hour,
                        'fuelConsumptionLiter',
                        sum_fuel_consumption_liter,
                        'weightPerDistance',
                        sum_weight_per_distance,
                        'weightPerFuelLiter',
                        sum_weight_per_fuel_liter,
                        'catchValuePerFuelLiter',
                        sum_catch_value_per_fuel_liter,
                        'livingWeight',
                        sum_living_weight,
                        'numTrips',
                        num_trips::BIGINT,
                        'numHauls',
                        num_hauls::BIGINT,
                        'tripDurationSeconds',
                        trip_duration_seconds::BIGINT,
                        'valueNok',
                        value_nok
                    )
                ),
                '[]'
            )::TEXT AS "per_vessel!"
        FROM
            other_vessel_trips
    )
SELECT
    *
FROM
    other_vessels o
    INNER JOIN logged_in_user_values l ON TRUE
    INNER JOIN other_vessel_stats v ON TRUE
    INNER JOIN per_trip p ON TRUE
    INNER JOIN average_carbon_intensity_and_eeoi c ON TRUE
